افتتحن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَتَحْنَ (iftataḥna) /if.ta.taħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اُفْتُتِحْنَ (uftutiḥna) /uf.tu.tiħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اِفْتَتِحْنَ (iftatiḥna) /if.ta.tiħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
